workouts.title: Day 1 Workout (Phase 1: Foundation)

strength.notes: Focus on form, controlled tempo. Core engagement on bench.

cycling.notes: Easy aerobic work. Establish consistency. Can talk during ride.

nutrition.notes: 500 kcal deficit from TDEE. Eat protein at every meal.

workouts.notes: Welcome to Day 1! Your goal this phase: build aerobic base + establish training habit. Do strength FIRST in morning, cycling in evening or separate session. Stay hydrated (3L+). Aim for 2 hard sessions (strength+cycling on same day is ok for recovery).

phase1.weeklyStructure: 3x strength (6-8 reps), 3x cycling (Z2 base + light intervals), 1x recovery

phase2.weeklyStructure: 3x strength (5-6 reps + accessories), 3x cycling (sweet-spot 88-94% FTP), 1x recovery
